title: The Properties pane opens on the clip line and lists only what is animating
goal: The panel beside a clip, title or sound starts with one line saying its name, where it starts and ends, how long it is and its speed, the way the mock draws it, and Animating lists only the values that are actually animating, with one button to animate another.
notes: Found in the side by side for the-video-properties-look-like-the-rest-of-the-d (queue/audits/2026-09-24-video-panel-side-by-side.png). Mock: docs/design/mocks/pages/video.html renderProps, .cliphead and the Animating .prow.anim rows plus #addProp. App: PropertyKeysInspector lists every keyRow; the Time section (SpeedInspector) now holds Speed/Length/Sound rows and a title On screen row, which the clip line would partly replace. Order rule is TimePanelOrder (PhotonzCore).
acceptance: With a clip, title or sound picked, the first thing under Layers is one line: name, in to out, length and speed, as video.html PROPERTIES draws it
Animating shows only keyed values, with an Animate a property button that opens a picker of the rest, as the mock draws it
A walk with no flags reads the clip line and the Animating count back for a clip and a title
The audit puts the shipped pane beside video.html PROPERTIES
Anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar, and written into this task's log if it does not

Mock video.html #gProps: header 'Properties' + kind chip + panel menu; .cliphead (name, in -> out, length . speed); 'Animating  N of M properties / nothing yet' + Graph; rows only for keyed values (diamond toggles a key AT THE PLAYHEAD, x on hover stops animating); '+ Animate a property' opens a grouped, searchable picker of the rest. App gaps: none blocking (popovers are drivable by walks). Plan: the Animating section becomes the dock's Properties section in a document with time and leads the panel; Time keeps Speed/Sound/Hold/Start Here/End Here/Fade but loses Length and On screen, which the clip line now says. ~14 walks and the a-title-that-moves guide press the dormant Position diamond; they move to the picker.
